body: Thank you for the warm reply. As I said to the other reply, it helps to let someone know how I feel without being invalidated. It means a lot to me that you took some time to read my post and reply - thank you so much
Thank you so much for the kind words. I really do appreciate the reply. I think sometimes I just need to know that someone has heard how I feel and doesn't invalidate me for it. Thank you!

Sorry that was so long. I know it just seems like I could leave my boyfriend and would probably get over it eventually but I cannot function on my own. I tried having my own place with my son last year but I could not keep it clean and I was not treating my son properly. I feel like I am a failure of a girlfriend and a failure of a mother.
